fusions.name: Dropped From the Rafters
fusions.desc: Drops onto the target for 30 damage and an extra 5% of its maximum health if it is a boss or elite, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tap Tap Tap
fusions.desc: Three rapid taps deal 11 damage, consume every affliction on the target to add their remaining damage, and stun it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Flattened Thin
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands. You slip 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Pound Away
fusions.desc: Every time you hit an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
